Problem Statement:
Fix the HTML export template

This PR fixes the HTML export template, addressing the issue raised in #3021

In doing so there's also an update to the pre-commit configuration (without it I wasn't able to commit the change -- the update is stolen from the same config file in Textual).

steps.message:
FILES: rich/_export_format.py:1-18, .pre-commit-config.yaml:1-43
ROOT CAUSE: The HTML export template has a structural error where the `<head>` tag is closed before the `<html>` tag starts, and the `<html>` tag is placed after the `<head>`.
CHANGE: 
1. In `rich/_export_format.py`, move the `<html>` tag to the top (before `<head>`) and ensure the structure is `<html><head>...</head><body>...</body></html>`.
2. Update `.pre-commit-config.yaml` to match the Textual configuration (as mentioned in the issue).
TEST: tests/test_console.py
